Fast forward to today, they operate a flourishing farm with 100 cows, branching into a variety of dairy products and agroforestry practices. Their sustainable approach incorporates cow dung biogas, rainwater management, and solar energy, ensuring a self-sufficient model that yields impressive annual profits while promoting environmental stewardship.

title: Mining millionaire gave 3,015 LA acres to create Griffith Park
description: In 1882, mining magnate Griffith J. Griffith acquired a vast ranch in the Santa Monica Mountains, later donating much of it to create Griffith Park in 1896. This park provided vital recreational areas and cultural amenities for the people of Los Angeles. While Griffith's personal life may complicate his legacy, the park remains a cherished asset for the community, showcasing its enduring value as a natural haven.

title: Op Firewall: ‘Joshita from Mumbai’, ‘Anvi from Delhi’ and the Pakistani spy trap
description: Andhra Pradesh's Counter Intelligence Cell, under "Operation Firewall-2026," has uncovered an alleged Pakistani espionage network spanning 10 states. Of 18 suspects, 13 are naval personnel. Fake female identities "Joshita Pall" and "Anvi Mehta" allegedly used Facebook, Instagram and WhatsApp honeytraps and money offers to extract ship and submarine details. Indian SIM cards, WhatsApp OTPs and crypto payments supported the operation. Two men have been arrested, and the investigation continues.

Nobel, who made his fortune through inventions including dynamite, specified that prizes should be awarded to those who had made the “greatest benefit to humankind” in five fields: Physics, Chemistry, Physiology or Medicine, Literature and Peace.

title: Ship with 32 million illegal cigarettes sank off Ireland; marine life took over
description: In a fascinating move, the MV Shingle was purposefully submerged along Ireland's northwest coast, transforming into a thriving artificial reef. Legal challenges and its deteriorating state made scrapping impractical, leading to its sinking in 2024. As marine life increasingly flourishes around the wreck, the area has seen a spike in biodiversity and year-round visitor interest, highlighting the necessity of effectively managing these ecological projects for lasting benefits.

description: In 1934, J.C. Hunter proposed a land donation to the government for national park purposes, though it did not proceed. Years later, in 1969, his son, J.C. The school, which aimed to support low-income children and families, faced challenges leading to its closure. About 540 children were enrolled, and families expressed concern over the abrupt announcement of the closure. The Chan Zuckerberg Initiative pledged $50 million to assist with transition services and education savings accounts.

title: TOI exclusive: Barred from temples, they made their bodies a shrine to Ram
description: Members of the Ramnami community in Chhattisgarh tattoo the name of Ram on their bodies as a form of devotion. This practice began over a century ago as a response to social exclusion from temples due to caste discrimination. However, the tradition of full-body tattooing is declining among younger generations who face modern societal challenges. While many still honor Ram through smaller tattoos, the original practice is fading away.

title: Lover made to drink woman’s urine, perform sex on camera: Chilling details from Gujarat
description: A couple was allegedly subjected to severe humiliation and torture after being traced by the woman's husband. They were taken to a house where a so-called purification ritual was conducted against them. The man was tied to a tree, forced to perform sexual acts, and drink urine. This incident was recorded and subsequently circulated on social media, leading to police intervention.

title: Patrick and Brittany Mahomes’ $1.6M philanthropy: How are they helping 20,000 kids?

Their efforts include a $1.625 million Boys & Girls Clubs commitment, a $1 million inclusive Kansas City playground, literacy programs reaching more than 20,000 students, community grants and food support for families facing hardship.

title: Varanasi woman 'thrashed' after finding husband HIV+; alleges rape bid by father-in-law
description: A woman from Varanasi, aged 25, has leveled allegations against her husband and in-laws for concealing his HIV positive status. The revelation came post-marriage in 2024, triggering harassment and violence from her in-laws, who persisted in demanding dowry despite her protestations. After enduring threats, she sought police help, and her complaint was filed on October 3, following initial reluctance to act on her case.

title: Man makes girlfriend drink acid under ‘suicide pact’ after marriage fixed elsewhere
description: A 23-year-old farmer named Banti Kumar was arrested for making his girlfriend, Pinki Devi, consume toilet-cleaning acid. Kumar reportedly pressured her into this act under the guise of a suicide pact. After realizing the severity of the situation, he fled, leaving her in pain. Pinki was later discovered and taken to a hospital where her condition improved.

title: 103-year-old WWII veteran still tends same Maryland bar after 63 years
description: Irv Koch, a 103-year-old World War II veteran, has tended the bar in the basement of his Pasadena, Maryland, home since 1963. More than six decades later, the cash-only tavern still has no fixed opening hours, with Irv starting the day when his first customer arrives and closing when patrons leave or he gets tired.
